en: Turbo adds features to the RayNeo app. Each feature has one row. Voice recognition stays with RayNeo and may use its cloud. Answers are read aloud on this phone and play through the glasses. Conversation memory keeps the last 50 answers until the app quits. Developer tools may call your configured services; a passing test does not prove the glasses showed it.
zh: Turbo 为 RayNeo App 增加功能，每项功能只有一个入口。语音识别仍由 RayNeo 完成，可能经过其云端。回答在本机朗读，经眼镜播放。对话上下文仅保留本次运行最近 50 条。开发者工具可能调用你配置的服务；测试通过不代表眼镜已显示。

en:
About me
Optional background the model may use, such as how to address you, your job or your city. Stored only on this iPhone and sent with each request to your own model. Up to 500 characters.
zh:
关于我
可选。供模型参考的背景信息，如称呼、职业或城市。只存在本机，并随每次自有模型请求发送。最多 500 字。

en:
Custom model
Enter the full HTTPS /chat/completions URL. The key is saved only in the phone’s Keychain. Leave blank to keep the old key for the same URL; changing the URL will not carry it over.
zh:
自有模型
填写完整 HTTPS /chat/completions 地址。Key 仅存手机钥匙串；留空保留同一地址的旧 Key，改地址不会带过去。

en:
Save final text
Saves only final recognized text received after enabling to the extension's local directory. It remains enabled after restart until you turn it off manually. Contains real conversation content; ensure everyone involved consents. Does not start the microphone and does not upload automatically.
zh:
保存最终文字
仅将之后收到的最终识别文字另存于本机扩展目录，重启后仍保持开启，直到你手动关闭。包含真实谈话内容，请确保相关人员同意。不启动麦克风，不自动上传。

en: Operates only on test IDs recorded by this tool; does not delete other cards. The current firmware may reject the test; failures are not retried automatically. Tap item 2 to restore the text card or item 4 to clean up.
zh: 只操作本工具记录的测试 ID，不删除其他卡片。测试可能被当前固件拒绝；失败不自动重试，恢复文字卡可点第2项，清理点第4项。

en: Your server → MCP → allowlisted display fields → Dashboard API or App ZIP → phone approval → glasses. App v1 is a manually installed data snapshot; automatic updates and button events sent back to the backend are not implemented yet. Do not use GitHub to store private data or keys.
zh: 用户 Server 连接 MCP → 白名单展示字段 → 仪表盘 API 或 App ZIP → 手机批准 → 眼镜。App v1 为手动安装的数据快照；自动更新和按钮事件回流尚未接通。不要把 GitHub 当作私有数据/密钥仓库。

en: Install this preview package only; does not flash firmware. Up to four apps; the same ID can only be updated to a higher version. Return the glasses to Home and finish other tasks first.
zh: 只安装此预览包，不刷固件。最多四个应用；相同 ID 仅允许更高版本更新。请让眼镜回首页并结束其他任务。

en: Use your own HTTPS service and phone-role token. Read its identity, then bind its device ID to the connected glasses. This attempt sends no cards.
zh: 使用自己的 HTTPS 服务及 phone 角色 Token。读取身份后，将其设备 ID 绑定到当前连接的眼镜；本轮不发送卡片。

en: Adds or updates this test card and moves it to the top; other cards move down in their original order. Demo values only; does not read accounts or computers. Older firmware does not support this native layout.
zh: 将新增/更新本测试卡并置顶，其余卡片按原序后移。仅演示数值，不读取账户和电脑。旧固件不支持该原生排版。

en:
Conversation memory
Clears only chat history in this extension's memory; RayNeo app records are not deleted. Ongoing custom model requests are canceled and RayNeo app mode is restored.
zh:
对话上下文
仅清空本扩展内存中的聊天历史，不删除官方记录。正在进行的自有请求会取消并恢复官方模式。

en:
Answer with
Choosing experimental takeover sends the recognized question to your configured service. Unknown functions still use the RayNeo app; without a validated chat template, only the selection is retained and takeover stays off.
zh:
回答方式
选择实验接管会将识别后的问题发给你配置的服务。未知业务仍走官方；无已验证聊天模板时只保留选择、不接管。

en:
Web search
When enabled, the custom model may send necessary search terms to TinyFish and receive search summaries. RayNeo app ASR is unchanged. Not suitable for sensitive searches. The API key is stored only in this device's Keychain; leave blank to retain the existing key.
zh:
联网搜索
开启后，自有模型可把必要检索词发给 TinyFish，将搜索摘要交回模型。官方 ASR 不变。不适合检索敏感信息。Key 仅存本机钥匙串；留空保留已有 Key。

en:
Takeover check
First confirm the chat-response domain for the current version. Complete one Q&A in RayNeo app mode; takeover can be enabled only after a developer verifies it.
zh:
接管校验
需要先确认当前版本的聊天回包 domain。请先用官方模式完成一次问答，开发者核对后才开启接管。

en:
Model tools
knowledge_query / knowledge_query_status: %@. Codex searches WeChat archives, projects, and learning materials in read-only mode and cites sources; it does not modify the knowledge base.

create_todo: Adds a title through the RayNeo app entry point. Confirmed only after a new ID appears in the list; no retry on timeout.
web_search: Public TinyFish search; internet access must be enabled.

To-do tools cannot edit, delete, complete, or set reminder times and currently do not write to knowledge base web pages. Only real voice sessions have the to-do execution context.
zh:
模型工具
knowledge_query / knowledge_query_status：%@。Codex只读检索微信归档、项目与学习资料，引用来源；不修改知识库。

create_todo：标题新增，交给官方入口；等待列表新ID才确认，超时不重试。
web_search：TinyFish公开搜索，需开启联网。

待办工具不支持修改、删除、完成、提醒时间，暂不写入知识库网页。只有真实语音会话拥有待办执行上下文。

en: Make sure everyone involved has agreed. It may use substantial storage. Audio is not uploaded. Files are not deleted automatically, and past recordings are not restored. This action does not start Lifelog.
zh: 可能占用较大空间，不上传、不自动删除，不恢复过去的录音。此操作本身不启动智记。

zh: 真实文件吞吐待验，超时后不会盲目重发。

zh: 休息和短时验收只用于眼镜模式；已有计时不会被覆盖。

en: This creates a glasses log archive that may contain private information. The extension receives this task; it makes no upload call, does not unzip automatically, and does not delete originals. Do not use RayNeo app log feedback until recovery is complete.
zh: 此操作会让眼镜生成日志归档；可能包含私人信息。扩展接收本次任务，不调用上传、不自动解压、不删除原件。未恢复前请勿操作官方日志反馈。
